summary: Public projects created on 7 April 2025: 3 repos.
intro: Three prompt collections cover privacy screening for shared prompt libraries, system prompts for refining speech-to-text output, and a utility for combining text transformation prompts.

projects.name: Prompt Library Privacy Screener
projects.description: Model for a PII screen (using Ollama) for open sourcing prompt libraries safely

projects.name: Speech To Text System Prompt Library
projects.description: An updated skeleton library of system prompts for using LLMs to refine STT output

projects.name: Text Transformation Prompt Combiner
projects.description: Basic implementation of a prompt concatenation utility for text transformation system prompts for converting transcribed text
